page.title: 結果へつなぐ so・such・too・rather

analysis.summaryJa: このページは、程度から結果へつなぐ so ... that・such ... that、限界を超えて不可能になる too ... to、二つの選択や好みを比べる rather A than B を扱う。so は形容詞・副詞、such は名詞句を中心にし、too は「必要以上」、rather は「むしろ」を表す。
grammarPoints: so + 形容詞・副詞 + that 節で程度と結果を表す
such + (a/an) + 形容詞 + 名詞 + that 節を作る
可算単数名詞では such a/an の語順にする
too + 形容詞・副詞 + to do は過度のため不可能・不適切を表す
rather A than B は B より A を選ぶことを表す
rather + 形容詞は「やや、かなり」という評価を示すことがある
visualEvidence: so の後ろに形容詞・副詞、such の後ろに名詞箱が置かれる二本のレールが描かれている
程度ゲージから that 節の結果へ矢印が伸び、so と such の結果構文を示している
too の目盛りが許容限界を越え、to 不定詞の行為に禁止印が付く図になっている
rather A than B の分岐路で A 側が選択され、比較される二項の平行性が示されている
commonTraps: so difficult task のように so を名詞句へ直接付ける
such useful advice で不可算名詞 advice に a を付ける
such a crowded that のように名詞を欠く
too ... that と so ... to を混同する
rather A than B で A と B の品詞・構造をそろえない
too を単なる very と考え、否定的な結果を読み落とす

questions.prompt: The shipment was ------- heavy that two employees were needed to move it.

choices.A: so
choices.C: too
choices.D: rather a

questions.translationJa: その荷物は非常に重かったので、運ぶのに従業員2人が必要でした。
questions.explanationJa: 形容詞 heavy の程度と that 節の結果を so ... that で結びます。

questions.prompt: It was ------- useful workshop that every department requested a follow-up session.

choices.A: so a
choices.C: too a
choices.D: rather

questions.translationJa: 非常に有益な研修だったので、全部門が追加回を希望しました。
questions.explanationJa: 可算単数名詞 workshop を含むため such a + 形容詞 + 名詞 + that の形です。

questions.prompt: The corridor is ------- narrow for the delivery cart to pass through safely.

choices.A: so
choices.C: too
choices.D: rather

questions.translationJa: その廊下は狭すぎて、配送用台車が安全に通れません。
questions.explanationJa: too narrow for ... to pass は、狭さが許容限界を超えたことを表します。

questions.prompt: The director would ------- postpone the launch than release an untested product.

choices.A: so
choices.C: such
choices.D: rather

questions.translationJa: 部長は未試験の商品を発売するより、発売を延期したいと考えています。
questions.explanationJa: would rather A than B で、B より A を選ぶ意向を示します。

questions.prompt: The technician worked ------- efficiently that the repair was completed before lunch.

choices.A: so
choices.C: too
choices.D: rather a

questions.translationJa: 技術者は非常に効率よく作業したため、修理は昼食前に完了しました。
questions.explanationJa: 副詞 efficiently の程度は so efficiently that で結果へつなぎます。

questions.prompt: The hotel provided ------- detailed directions that none of the visitors got lost.

choices.A: so
choices.C: too
choices.D: rather a

questions.translationJa: ホテルは非常に詳しい道案内を提供したので、来訪者は誰も迷いませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: 複数名詞 directions を中心とするため such + 形容詞 + 複数名詞 + that を使います。

questions.prompt: The attachment is ------- large to upload through the customer portal.

choices.A: so
choices.C: too
choices.D: rather

questions.translationJa: 添付ファイルは大きすぎて顧客ポータルからアップロードできません。
questions.explanationJa: too large to upload は、サイズが過大で行為が不可能なことを表します。

questions.prompt: We would ------- use the existing supplier than delay production while qualifying a new one.

choices.A: too
choices.C: so
choices.D: rather

questions.translationJa: 新しい仕入先を認定する間に生産を遅らせるより、既存の仕入先を使いたいと思います。
questions.explanationJa: would rather use A than delay B で、二つの行為から前者を選びます。

questions.prompt: The revised form is ------- complicated, but experienced staff can complete it without help.

choices.A: rather
choices.C: such a
choices.D: so that

questions.translationJa: 改訂された用紙はかなり複雑ですが、経験者なら助けなしで記入できます。
questions.explanationJa: rather complicated は予想より複雑という評価を示し、too のように不可能とは断定しません。

questions.prompt: There was ------- little notice that several regional managers could not attend.

choices.A: such
choices.C: too
choices.D: rather a

questions.translationJa: 案内期間があまりに短かったため、複数の地域責任者が参加できませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: little は量を表す形容詞で、so little ... that の定型になります。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing an extremely busy day and its result.

choices.A: The office was such busy that temporary staff were called in.
choices.B: The office was too busy that temporary staff were called in.
choices.C: The office was so busy that temporary staff were called in.
choices.D: The office was so a busy that temporary staff were called in.

questions.translationJa: 事務所が非常に忙しかったので、臨時スタッフが呼ばれました。
questions.explanationJa: 形容詞 busy には so を使い、that 節で結果を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing a memorable customer event.

choices.A: It was so successful event that the client booked another one.
choices.B: It was such successful an event that the client booked another one.
choices.C: It was too a successful event that the client booked another one.
choices.D: It was such a successful event that the client booked another one.

questions.translationJa: 非常に成功したイベントだったため、顧客は次回も予約しました。
questions.explanationJa: 可算単数 event には such a successful event の語順を使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence explaining why a document cannot be mailed.

choices.A: The document is too confidential to send by ordinary mail.
choices.B: The document is so confidential to send by ordinary mail.
choices.C: The document is such confidential to send by ordinary mail.
choices.D: The document is too confidentiality to send by ordinary mail.

questions.translationJa: その文書は機密性が高すぎて普通郵便では送れません。
questions.explanationJa: too confidential to send は過度のため行為が不適切・不可能であることを示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence stating a preference between two actions.

choices.A: I would rather calling the customer than send another automated message.
choices.B: I would rather call the customer than send another automated message.
choices.C: I would rather call the customer than sending another automated message.
choices.D: I rather would call the customer from send another automated message.

questions.translationJa: 自動メッセージをもう一度送るより、顧客に電話したいです。
questions.explanationJa: would rather の後と than の後は動詞原形をそろえます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence linking careful work to a positive result.

choices.A: The clerk checked the figures such carefully that no error remained.
choices.B: The clerk checked the figures too carefully that no error remained.
choices.C: The clerk checked the figures so carefully that no error remained.
choices.D: The clerk checked so the figures carefully that no error remained.

questions.translationJa: 担当者が非常に注意深く数値を確認したため、誤りは残りませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: 副詞 carefully を so で修飾し、that 節へ結果をつなぎます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence using an uncountable noun in a result construction.

choices.A: The consultant gave such a practical advice that we changed the rollout plan.
choices.B: The consultant gave so practical advice that we changed the rollout plan.
choices.C: The consultant gave too practical advice that we changed the rollout plan.
choices.D: The consultant gave such practical advice that we changed the rollout plan.

questions.translationJa: コンサルタントが非常に実用的な助言をしたので、展開計画を変更しました。
questions.explanationJa: advice は不可算名詞なので a を付けず such practical advice とします。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a room that cannot hold the group.

choices.A: The room is too small to accommodate all fifty participants.
choices.B: The room is so small to accommodate all fifty participants.
choices.C: The room is such small that accommodate all fifty participants.
choices.D: The room too is small that all fifty participants.

questions.translationJa: その部屋は小さすぎて参加者50人全員を収容できません。
questions.explanationJa: too small to accommodate で収容不可能を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence comparing two work arrangements.

choices.A: Ms. Rao would rather working remotely than commute during the storm.
choices.B: Ms. Rao would rather work remotely than commute during the storm.
choices.C: Ms. Rao would work rather remotely than commutes during the storm.
choices.D: Ms. Rao rather would work remotely from commute during the storm.

questions.translationJa: ラオさんは嵐の中を通勤するより在宅勤務をしたいと思っています。
questions.explanationJa: would rather work than commute と動詞原形を平行にします。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence giving a somewhat negative evaluation.

choices.A: The revised procedure is rather cumbersomely for a routine request.
choices.B: The revised procedure rather is cumbersome a routine request for.
choices.C: The revised procedure is rather cumbersome for a routine request.
choices.D: The revised procedure is a rather cumbersome for a routine request.

questions.translationJa: 改訂された手順は日常的な申請にはかなり面倒です。
questions.explanationJa: be 動詞の補語には形容詞 cumbersome を置き、rather が程度を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a very large number of inquiries.

choices.A: We received such many inquiries that the response deadline was extended.
choices.B: We received too many inquiries that the response deadline was extended.
choices.C: We received so much inquiries that the response deadline was extended.
choices.D: We received so many inquiries that the response deadline was extended.

questions.translationJa: 問い合わせが非常に多かったため、回答期限が延長されました。
questions.explanationJa: 可算複数 inquiries の量は so many ... that で表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The box was too heavy to lift alone.”

choices.A: The box was so heavy that one person could not lift it.
choices.B: The box was light enough for one person to lift.
choices.C: One person lifted the box because it was heavy.
choices.D: The box was such a lift that it became lighter.

questions.translationJa: その箱は重すぎて1人では持ち上げられませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: too heavy to は so heavy that ... could not と言い換えられます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “It was such a useful guide that we printed extra copies.”

choices.A: The guide was too useful to be printed.
choices.B: The guide was so useful that we produced additional copies.
choices.C: We printed fewer copies because the guide was useless.
choices.D: The guide was useful rather than printed.

questions.translationJa: 非常に役立つ案内だったため、追加部数を印刷しました。
questions.explanationJa: such a useful guide that と so useful that は中心構造を変えて同じ結果を表せます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “I would rather wait than accept incomplete data.”

choices.A: I will accept incomplete data before waiting.
choices.B: Waiting and accepting incomplete data are equally required.
choices.C: I prefer waiting to accepting data that is incomplete.
choices.D: I am too impatient to wait for any data.

questions.translationJa: 不完全なデータを受け入れるより待ちたいです。
questions.explanationJa: would rather A than B は B より A を好む意味です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The instructions were so confusing that we called support.”

choices.A: The support team made the instructions clear before we read them.
choices.B: The instructions were too clear for support to understand.
choices.C: We called support even though the instructions required no help.
choices.D: Because the instructions were extremely unclear, we contacted support.

questions.translationJa: 説明が非常に分かりにくかったため、サポートへ電話しました。
questions.explanationJa: so confusing that は強い程度が結果を引き起こしたことを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The deadline is rather tight.”

choices.A: The available time is somewhat shorter than is comfortable.
choices.C: The deadline is too distant to matter.
choices.D: The deadline is a type of tight object.

questions.translationJa: 締切はかなり厳しいです。
questions.explanationJa: rather tight は「予想より厳しい、やや厳しい」という評価です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “There was such heavy traffic that the courier arrived late.”

choices.A: The courier arrived early despite having no traffic.
choices.B: The courier was delayed because traffic was extremely heavy.
choices.C: Traffic was too light for the courier to move.
choices.D: The courier preferred traffic rather than delivery.

questions.translationJa: 交通が非常に混雑していたため、配達員は遅れて到着しました。
questions.explanationJa: such heavy traffic that は不可算名詞 traffic を中心に結果を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The password is too short to meet the security rule.”

choices.A: The password exceeds every required length.
choices.B: The security rule is too short to read.
choices.C: The password is not long enough to satisfy the security requirement.
choices.D: A short password is required by the rule.

questions.translationJa: そのパスワードは短すぎてセキュリティ規則を満たしません。
questions.explanationJa: too short to と not long enough to は同じ不足関係を表します。
questions.focus: too と enough の対応

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “We chose email rather than postal mail.”

choices.A: We used both email and postal mail equally.
choices.B: Postal mail was chosen instead of email.
choices.C: Email was too slow to be considered.
choices.D: We selected email instead of sending the item by post.

questions.translationJa: 郵便ではなくメールを選びました。
questions.explanationJa: rather than は後ろの選択肢を退け、前の選択肢を採用します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The speaker talked so quietly that people in back could not hear.”

choices.A: The speaker’s very low volume prevented people at the back from hearing.
choices.B: Everyone heard because the speaker talked loudly.
choices.C: The audience was too quiet to hear the speaker.
choices.D: People at the back left before the talk began.

questions.translationJa: 話し手の声が非常に小さかったため、後方の人には聞こえませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: so quietly that は話し方の程度と聞こえない結果を結びます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “It was such an urgent request that we responded immediately.”

choices.A: The request was not urgent enough to answer.
choices.B: The request was so urgent that we answered at once.
choices.C: We postponed the request because it was ordinary.
choices.D: The request was too immediate to be urgent.

questions.translationJa: 非常に緊急の依頼だったため、すぐに対応しました。
questions.explanationJa: such an urgent request that は so urgent that に言い換えられます。

questions.prompt: The loading dock ceiling is 2.5 meters high, but the truck is 3 meters high. The truck is ------- to enter.

choices.A: so tall
choices.C: too tall
choices.D: rather a tall

questions.translationJa: 積み込み場の天井は2.5メートルですが、トラックは3メートルあります。トラックは高すぎて入れません。
questions.explanationJa: 数値から物理的に不可能なので too tall to enter が適切です。

questions.prompt: The seminar received excellent ratings, and every seat for the next session was booked in one hour. It was ------- that the organizer added a third date.

choices.A: so a popular event
choices.C: rather popularity
choices.D: such a popular event

questions.translationJa: セミナーは高評価を受け、次回の全席が1時間で予約されました。非常に人気のイベントだったため、主催者は3日目を追加しました。
questions.explanationJa: event は可算単数なので such a popular event that を使います。

questions.prompt: The receptionist explained the route slowly and repeated each landmark. She spoke ------- that the visitor found the office without difficulty.

choices.A: so clearly
choices.C: too clear
choices.D: rather a clearly

questions.translationJa: 受付担当者は道順をゆっくり説明し、目印を繰り返しました。非常に明瞭に話したので、来訪者は迷わず事務所へ着きました。
questions.explanationJa: 副詞 clearly を so で強め、that 節へ結果をつなぎます。

questions.prompt: The manager does not want to rush a decision with incomplete figures. She says, “I would ------- wait for the final report than guess.”

choices.A: too
choices.C: such
choices.D: so

questions.translationJa: 管理者は不完全な数値で判断を急ぎたくありません。「推測するより最終報告を待ちたい」と言います。
questions.explanationJa: would rather wait than guess で二つの行為を比較します。

questions.prompt: The customer file contains bank details and identification numbers. It is ------- sensitive to leave on an unlocked desk.

choices.A: so
choices.C: too
choices.D: rather a

questions.translationJa: 顧客ファイルには銀行情報と身分証番号が含まれています。機密性が高すぎて、無施錠の机に置いておけません。
questions.explanationJa: 安全上不適切な過度の程度を too sensitive to leave で表します。

questions.prompt: The branch received 600 applications for only twelve positions. There were ------- that the review period had to be extended.

choices.A: such many applications
choices.C: rather much applications
choices.D: so many applications

questions.translationJa: 12枠に600件の応募がありました。応募が非常に多かったため、審査期間を延長する必要がありました。
questions.explanationJa: 可算複数 applications には so many ... that を使います。

questions.prompt: The team can either redesign the entire package or replace one damaged label. They choose the smaller intervention. They will replace the label ------- redesign the package.

choices.A: rather than
choices.C: too to
choices.D: such as

questions.translationJa: チームは包装全体の再設計か、破損ラベル1枚の交換を選べます。小さい対応を選び、包装を再設計するのではなくラベルを交換します。
questions.explanationJa: rather than で後者を退け、前の行為を選びます。

questions.prompt: The warehouse received ------- that staff had to use an overflow storage area.

choices.A: so a large shipment
choices.C: too large shipment
choices.D: rather large a shipment

questions.translationJa: 倉庫には非常に大口の荷物が届いたため、職員は臨時保管場所を使わなければなりませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: 可算単数 shipment には such a large shipment that を使います。

questions.prompt: The proposed form works, but it requires six approvals for a routine purchase. Reviewers call it ------- cumbersome.

choices.A: so that
choices.C: rather
choices.D: too to

questions.translationJa: 提案された用紙は機能しますが、日常購入に6件の承認が必要です。確認者はかなり面倒だと評価します。
questions.explanationJa: 実行不能とは断定せず、やや否定的な評価をする rather cumbersome が合います。

questions.prompt: A data-entry error was repeated across every regional report. The mistake was ------- widespread that all reports had to be reissued.

choices.A: such
choices.C: rather a
choices.D: so

questions.translationJa: 入力ミスが全地域報告書に繰り返されました。誤りが非常に広範囲だったため、全報告書を再発行する必要がありました。
questions.explanationJa: 形容詞 widespread の強い程度と結果を so ... that で結びます。
